hints.title: Boarding Process Simulation
hints.text: Sort buses and passengers by departure and arrival times to simulate who boards each bus in order.

hints.title: Last Boarding Opportunity
hints.text: Determine whether the last bus has remaining capacity. If yes, you could arrive at bus departure. If no, you must arrive before the last boarded passenger.

hints.title: Avoiding Duplicate Times
hints.text: Step backward from the initial target timestamp until finding a time where no other passenger arrived.

hints.title: Simulation and Step Back Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def latestTimeCatchBus(self, buses: list[int], passengers: list[int], capacity: int) -> int:
        buses.sort()
        passengers.sort()
        j = 0
        m = len(passengers)
        for bus in buses:
            cap = capacity
            while cap > 0 and j < m and passengers[j] <= bus:
                j += 1
                cap -= 1
        last_time = buses[-1] if cap > 0 else passengers[j - 1]
        pset = set(passengers)
        while last_time in pset:
            last_time -= 1
        return last_time
```

complexity.time: O(b log b + p log p)
complexity.notes: Sorting is dominant. Step back runs in at most O(p) iterations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every potential arrival time one by one is too slow.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Passenger hash set allows O(1) existence checks during step back.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simulates boarding capacity sequentially and correctly handles full versus empty last bus cases.
